rules.supportingIndicator: {{stage2_accreditedFacilities}} of {{stage1_eligibleFacilities}} facilities accredited for this benefit
rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate: (1) Complex accreditation requirements, (2) Limited facility awareness of benefit, (3) Insufficient implementation support resources, (4) Documentation or capacity barriers, (5) Eligibility criteria unclear or restrictive
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Which facilities attempted accreditation, Reasons for non-participation, Whether facilities are aware of the benefit, Capacity constraints at facility level, Actual eligibility if official criteria differ
rules.suggestedInvestigation: Survey sample of non-accredited facilities; Review accreditation application data for rejection reasons; Interview regional coordinators on outreach effectiveness; Verify official eligibility criteria; Assess technical assistance availability
rules.possibleInstitutionalDecisions: Consider: (1) Review and simplify accreditation requirements if appropriate, (2) Launch targeted facility engagement campaign, (3) Provide technical assistance for applications, (4) Clarify eligibility criteria officially, (5) Assess whether benefit design aligns with facility capacity

rules.observedFinding: Only {{filingRate}}% of accredited facilities are filing claims
rules.supportingIndicator: {{stage3_filingFacilities}} of {{stage2_accreditedFacilities}} accredited facilities have submitted claims
rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate: (1) Services not activated post-accreditation, (2) Provider awareness gaps about claims process, (3) Lower patient demand than anticipated, (4) Claims submission barriers, (5) Administrative capacity constraints
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Which accredited facilities have activated services, Provider training completion status, Patient demand levels, Specific claims process barriers, Whether low filing reflects low service delivery or only low administrative reporting
rules.suggestedInvestigation: Verify service activation status at accredited facilities; Survey providers on benefit awareness and claims process challenges; Review claims rejection patterns; Assess patient referral and awareness; Distinguish service delivery from claims filing
rules.possibleInstitutionalDecisions: Consider: (1) Post-accreditation provider training program, (2) Simplified claims submission process, (3) Patient and provider awareness campaigns, (4) Monitor service activation timelines, (5) Assess whether benefit design meets patient needs

rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate: (1) Documentation quality issues, (2) Eligibility verification challenges, (3) Service coding errors, (4) Claims process complexity, (5) Unclear benefit rules
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Top denial reasons by category, Whether denials are systematic or facility-specific, Whether denied claims are corrected and resubmitted, Training gaps at facility level

rules.observedFinding: Average time from service to payment is {{averageDaysToPayment}} days
rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate: (1) Processing capacity constraints, (2) Documentation review backlogs, (3) Payment system delays, (4) Multiple approval layers
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Breakdown of delays by processing stage (acceptance, adjudication, approval, disbursement), Whether delays are systemic or case-specific, Impact on provider cash flow and participation
rules.suggestedInvestigation: Map processing timeline by stage; Identify bottleneck stages; Assess processing capacity; Interview facilities on impact of payment delays; Distinguish approval delays from disbursement delays
rules.possibleInstitutionalDecisions: Consider: (1) Increase adjudication capacity, (2) Streamline approval workflow, (3) Expedite disbursement processing, (4) Communicate expected timelines to providers clearly

rules.observedFinding: Large variation in implementation rates across regions
rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate: (1) Variable regional coordination effectiveness, (2) Urban-rural infrastructure gaps, (3) Differential resource availability, (4) Best practices not shared across regions, (5) Regional eligibility patterns if actual criteria differ
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Regional context differences (facility mix, population mental health needs), Coordinator capacity and resources by region, Whether low rates reflect eligibility or implementation barriers, Actual geographic distribution if using illustrative eligibility
rules.suggestedInvestigation: Interview high-performing regional coordinators to document success factors; Assess infrastructure and resource differences; Review regional facility eligibility patterns; Verify whether variation reflects implementation or structural factors; Check if official eligibility criteria affect regional patterns differently
rules.possibleInstitutionalDecisions: Consider: (1) Share best practices via regional coordinator network, (2) Provide additional support to lower-performing regions, (3) Adjust resource allocation based on need and context, (4) Verify official eligibility criteria to understand true eligible facility distribution
rules.additionalNote: Regional patterns in this demonstration are simulated and do not represent actual geographic findings

rules.observedFinding: Implementation shows strong uptake across stages
rules.potentialExplanation: This MAY indicate effective implementation strategy and strong facility engagement
rules.evidenceLimitations: We do not know: Quality of services, Patient outcomes, Whether service delivery volumes match administrative reporting, Impact on patient access and satisfaction
rules.suggestedInvestigation: Continue monthly monitoring of trends; Document success factors for potential replication; Begin outcome evaluation (patient access, quality, satisfaction); Assess actual service delivery beyond administrative metrics
rules.possibleInstitutionalDecisions: Consider: (1) Maintain current implementation approach, (2) Document and share success factors, (3) Shift focus to quality and outcome measurement, (4) Plan outcome evaluation study
